test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that completes the sentence using the correct spelling.

The lights of the Aurora Borealis are a natural _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the word is **'phenomenon'**.
 
• **'Phenomenon'** is a noun that refers to an observable fact or event, especially one that is unusual or remarkable.
 
• Incorrect spellings like 'phenominon,' 'phenominnon,' or 'phinominon' are common err
